description: Adipic acid + hexamethylenediamine amide synthetases (nylon-6,6). Step-1 models the carboxylate-activation half-reaction only.

step.chosen_because: Modeling the carboxylate-activation half-reaction (adenylation/phosphorylation); the enzyme's mechanism class is selected from its activation mode.

enzyme_state.rationale: These adenylating amide synthetases are modeled as the intact single-chain enzyme; no autocatalytic maturation or reviewed multichain assembly is annotated.

substrates.rationale: Adipate is the carboxylate that is adenylated; modeled as the dianion (RDKit net charge -2) matching its physiological protonation, and set as the single affinity/geometry target.
Hexamethylenediamine is the amine co-substrate of the second half-reaction; step-1 models only carboxylate activation, so it is omitted to isolate the adenylation geometry.

catalytic_metal.rationale: Catalytic Mg2+ is reasoned per active site from the candidate's mechanism/family (ANL adenylate -> one Mg, two-metal phosphoryl transfer -> two) and scaled by the modeled oligomeric state. Any UniProt metal tally is a cross-check reference only, since it conflates per-subunit vs per-assembly and binding-site labels.

geometry.rationale: Near-attack geometry (carboxylate O -> reactive phosphate along the leaving-group axis) is recorded as a post-hoc measurement target for geometry-first ranking; it is never imposed as a restraint.
